items.title: Inventory root-level documentation and classify target homes
items.context: List root Markdown documents, separate entrypoint/compatibility files from requirements decisions, guides, notes, and archive candidates. Keep the output scoped to a migration guide so unrelated Layer4 runtime changes are not touched.
items.userSees: The migration guide contains a table listing all root Markdown files and classifies each as stay-root, move-to-decision, move-to-guide, note/archive, or future compatibility work.

happy.desc: Guide lists every current root Markdown file found by root-level Markdown inventory and assigns a target-home classification.

edge.desc: Host entrypoint files including README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and KOALA.md are not prescribed for blind relocation and remain discoverable from root until a separate compatibility story changes them.

adversarial.desc: Guide does not import unrelated Layer4 or Production Safety runtime claims and does not treat untracked or dirty docs as completed migrations.

items.title: Write the migration guide and upgrade instructions
items.context: Add a small document under docs/requirements/decisions or docs/guide that explains recommended locations, filename mapping, migration order, compatibility/redirect strategy, and reference update rules. It must not claim that migration is complete unless files are actually moved.

items.title: Publish a visible scope-boundary audit note
items.context: Add or include in the migration guide a short audit note that readers can inspect: it must name the known root documents, state which files stay at root, state that no bulk move was performed in this story, and explicitly say the guide does not unlock Production Safety or global capability claims.
